status: frozen before any sealed outcome value was read by the model developer
context_of_use: U1 initial-state prediction of a new study's control-group mean central corneal thickness (fraction of its preoperative CCT) at the study's follow-up months, from species, procedure, series kind and the preoperative CCT only
U2 causal forecasting of each group mean's next follow-up (control and treated groups) from its own earlier follow-ups
U3 landmark forecasting of every later follow-up of each group mean from its first postoperative measurement only
not_claimed: treatment-effect prediction (treated groups use the control prior of their context)
single-eye prediction (development single-eye initial state: 2 eyes, 22 pp)
clinical decision use (for example corneal decompensation or graft-failure thresholds)
contexts without a training study except through the declared family fallback
non-human species (the rabbit family has one development study and no prior)
measurement-device equivalence (fractions are taken within each series' device)

model.kinetics: ln f(t) = ell + e r(t), r(t) = (1 + t1/tau)/(1 + t/tau), t1 = 1 day, t in months, f = CCT / preoperative CCT
model.families: host (cataract, glaucoma, phakic IOL, vitreoretinal): theta = (ell, e, ln tau); graft (DSAEK, DMEK, PK, DALK, other): ell = L - ln(CCT0/550 um), theta = (L, e, ln tau), the long-term level pooled as absolute thickness
model.computation: given ln tau the law is linear in (level, e): exact Gaussian posteriors on an 80-point tau grid 0.002..120 months, mixtures over noise levels, Student-t scale-mixture nodes and robust components; quantiles from the exact mixture CDF
model.observation: Gaussian noise in ln f; SD per (study, family, series kind) from best fits of series with >=4 follow-ups; a new study's SD marginalized over log-normal(log-SD 0.5) around the family/kind median, floor 0.005
model.hierarchy: per family: family mean, procedure context effect, study effect, series deviation (group mean or single eye); diagonal covariances by penalized REML (Gamma(2) SD modes 0.05, 0.05, 0.5) on per-series likelihood-information summaries (weak prior N(0,1) on level and e, near-uniform ln tau, subtracted; directions below 0.05 weak-prior precisions carry no weight)
model.fallback: a context absent from training uses its family mean with the context variance added; a family with <2 training studies has no population prior
model.forecasting: population_assimilation_robust: population Gaussian prior mixed 0.8/0.2 with a broad component (SD 0.3, 0.3, 2.0 added), exact posterior given the prefix
development_changes_before_freeze: round 0 (in-sample, development series with >=4 follow-ups): hyperbolic return adopted over exponential and power 0.5/2 laws (host group-mean dof-adjusted log-SD 0.0094 vs 0.0120/0.0123/0.0105; graft nearly equal)
round 0 structural choice: graft family pools the long-term level as absolute thickness (physiology, not fitted)
round 1 LOSO (weak-prior moment summaries): robust next-observation 4.70 pp, landmark 4.73 pp; graft summaries uninformative about ln tau pulled REML estimates toward the weak prior's centre

round 2 LOSO (likelihood-information summaries, declared before the run, adopted by the declared rule): robust next-observation 4.67 pp, landmark 4.75 pp; primary chosen by the rule declared before round 1

methods.secondary_U3: same set as U2, all from the first follow-up only
methods.selection_rule: declared before round 1: lowest pooled development next-observation RMSE among population variants with next-observation coverage inside both windows; ties within 0.05 pp to the simpler variant

training: all 33 development records (69 series; 37 reserved development studies minus 2 not extractable and 2 excluded as outcome-selected); controls fit the population, all series give noise and analog-library inputs; for each sealed study the development studies linked to it by the author-overlap rule are removed from its training set

excluded_by_custodians.cct-pmc10011236: model-based medians only (no observed per-arm follow-up means)
excluded_by_custodians.cct-pmc10032283: cohort selected for postoperative corneal edema (outcome-selected)

sealed_test.custodians: two separate sub-agents extracted sealed records and reported only structure and hashes
sealed_test.structure_seen_before_freeze: the developer saw the custodians' structural summaries only: contexts human/cataract, human/glaucoma and human/vitreoretinal (custodian 1; no training study for glaucoma or vitreoretinal, family fallback), human/cataract, human/dmek and human/other (custodian 2); 29 series, 2 single eyes; methods, value kinds (all cct_absolute) and licence classes; no thickness value

criteria.per_series_U2: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence
criteria.per_series_U3: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence (first follow-up carried forward)
criteria.unit: percentage points of each series' preoperative CCT
criteria.H1_calibration: pooled population_assimilation_robust next-observation coverage: 90% interval within [0.80,0.97] AND 80% interval within [0.70,0.90]
criteria.H2_accuracy: pooled next-observation RMSE of population_assimilation_robust lower than persistence AND lower than last_two_log_linear over common targets
criteria.H3_landmark: pooled landmark RMSE of population_assimilation_robust lower than persistence over common targets; calibration windows reported
criteria.H4_initial_state: population_initial_state per control group with the per-group criterion; pooled RMSE versus pooled_training_curve and coverage reported
criteria.reported_not_tested: comparison with preoperative_level (f = 1), per family results, controls-only counts
criteria.all_points: every sealed series/target is scored; none removed; thresholds unchanged after unsealing

publication_operator: uv run --frozen python scripts/publish_thickness_population.py --sealed --report <dir>/report.json --output <new public dir>
